_README: Impressum data for /imprint, and the controller named in /privacy.
German law (§5 DDG) requires a natural person running a publicly available
digital service to state: full name, a ladungsfähige Anschrift (a real street
address where post can legally be served — NOT a P.O. box, NOT a packing
station), and a way to be contacted quickly and electronically (email).
Fill the fields below in and redeploy. While any of name, street, city or
email is empty the pages render a loud unfinished-notice instead of a legally
useless half-imprint, so you cannot ship this by accident.
phone        not required by §5 DDG as long as email is present.
responsible  only needed under §18 (2) MStV if you ever publish
journalistic-editorial content here. A randomizer is not that,
name: Fabian Zöllner
